title: Restriction to selected product inputs
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $f:\Omega^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a linear threshold function, and choose two elements of $\Omega$ at each coordinate, denoted $u_i^+$ and $u_i^-$. The function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ that evaluates $f$ at the input whose $i$th coordinate is $u_i^+$ when $x_i=1$ and $u_i^-$ otherwise is a linear threshold function.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from $\Omega^n$ to the signs
$f$ is a product linear threshold function
Two selected values $u_i^+,u_i^-\in\Omega$ are specified for each coordinate
